definitions.explanation: Tight, stretchy shorts or leggings, from mid-thigh to ankle length, worn for sports and exercise or under a skirt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧スパッツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。

⟦{娘|むすめ}→娘：02263_musume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}る→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦スカート→スカート：01060_sukaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いつも→いつも：00599_itsumo⟧スパッツ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧はかせて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My daughter runs around a lot, so I always have her wear stretch shorts under her skirt.

notes:
From English "spats", but in everyday use a false friend: it almost always means stretch shorts or leggings, rarely the gaiters worn over shoes. Worn with はく.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦レギンス→レギンス：20176_reginsu⟧: leggings — the newer fashion word, usually ankle length
- ⟦タイツ→タイツ：04683_taitsu⟧: tights — cover the feet
